Our 24 pack Crayons purchase for this school year are all very fragile. The tops all began snapping of on the first day of school. The students were not putting too much pressure on the crayons. ### Not preferred by all teachers

4 years ago

The color choices are strange. For basic coloring, there should be each of the 3 primary and 3 secondary colors, brown, white, and black. Then there should be light/pastel versions of each of these (pink, peach, pale yellow, light green, light blue, light purple, beige, grey.) Then there should be red-orange, yellow-orange, blue-green, red-violet. Then there should be maybe a darker pink color and a couple of other skin tones in addition to the brown/beige peach.

No, I do not recommend this product.

Colorful Care Team

Thank you for sharing the colors you'd like to see in the Crayola 24-count Crayons. We are sorry this assortment doesn't meet your colorful expectations. For many years, this assortment has been preferred by teachers, but we also understand that teachers may like a wider assortment to choose from. Our team is here if you'd like to share more about how we can improve on this product. Feel free to contact us at 1-800-CRAYOLA. - Chris, Colorful Care Team 

saj1624

Age 45 to 54

2 out of 5 stars.

### Where has the quality gone?

9 months ago

Crayola Crayons have always been a dependable high quality crayon. The last years quality has gone down hill. This year takes the cake. I am an elementary school teacher and all the teachers agree that crayons are made thinner and break without effort. A crayon just needs to roll off the desk and it either snaps in half or the tip breaks off. For the students who take great pride in how they take care of the crayons - it's very upsetting. What was really an eye opener was finding an old box of crayons (about 5 or 6 years old ) in the back of my supply closet! The difference in quality was unmistakable. I can't believe that a company like Crayola has taken the cheap road. I know our school is looking for another brand of crayon that won't break so easily. It's frustrating to me as a teacher....but so much more frustrating for the kids trying to color! Come on Crayola! Bring back the quality !

Originally posted on crayola.com

9 months ago

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with our 24 ct. Crayons. As an educator, your perspective is incredibly valuable, and we truly appreciate your dedication to your students and their creative experiences. We’re sorry to hear that the recent quality hasn’t met expectations. Durability is especially important in classroom settings, and we understand how frustrating it can be when crayons break easily—especially for young artists who take pride in caring for their supplies. Your comparison to older Crayola crayons is noted, and we’ll be sure to pass your feedback along to our product team. If you’d like to share more details or speak with someone directly, our team is available at 1-800-CRAYOLA. We hope to speak with you soon. -Taylor, Colorful Care Team
